items.prompt: Why use explicit failure returns in these acceptance tests instead of only assert?

options.text: Every assert runs even when NDEBUG is defined
Explicit returns make a later external transaction atomic
options.why: They only report this program test outcome.
Necessary runtime validation must not depend on an optional macro.

options.text: static_assert can inspect every runtime request

items.explanation: A release macro must not remove required validation/effects or the only test failure signal.
